faqs.a:
Section
5.16
of the Charter authorizes city council to adopt supplementary provisions by ordinance
               for initiative and referendum.
Section 13.9
of the Charter describes the manner in which the Charter may be amended. It is the
               purpose of this article to clarify the procedures to be followed for initiative, referendum,
               and Charter amendments without modifying the Charter.
(Code 1981, § 11-22; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
